spec/tests/reviewer_feature_spec.rb.after:
# frozen_string_literal: true
require_relative '../../lib/path_tracker/page'
RSpec.describe PathTracker::Page do
  it 'ignores a missing IP without recording a visit' do
    page = described_class.new('/home')
    page.add_visit(nil)
    expect(page.visits_count).to eq(0)
  end
end
